mapper.select: SELECT id, revision, file_count, created_at FROM knowledge_text_import_batch WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}

SELECT e.id, e.ordinal, e.file_name, e.source_sha256, e.source_bytes, e.source_characters, e.state, e.import_record_id, e.source_path, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_text_import r WHERE r.owner_id=e.owner_id AND r.source_sha256=e.source_sha256) AS has_registered_source FROM knowledge_text_import_batch_entry e WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY e.ordinal
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_text_import_batch (id, owner_id, revision, file_count, created_at) VALUES (#{batch.id}, #{owner}, #{batch.revision}, #{batch.total}, #{batch.createdAt})

INSERT INTO knowledge_text_import_batch_entry (id, owner_id, batch_id, ordinal, file_name, source_sha256, source_bytes, source_characters, state, import_record_id, source_path) VALUES (#{entry.id}, #{owner}, #{batchId}, #{entry.ordinal}, #{entry.fileName}, #{entry.sourceSha256}, #{entry.sourceBytes}, #{entry.sourceCharacters}, #{entry.state}, #{entry.importRecordId}, #{entry.sourcePath})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_text_import_batch_entry SET state=#{state}, import_record_id=#{recordId} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND batch_id=#{batchId} AND id=#{entryId} AND state='PENDING'
UPDATE knowledge_text_import_batch SET revision=revision+1 WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision} AND revision < file_count
